channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: 3 Ways to Boost MoE Inference on NVIDIA DGX Spark
item.description: An NVIDIA post explains three ways to speed up Ling-3.0-flash inference on DGX Spark: MoE kernels, FP8 output-layer quantization and multi-token prediction.

item.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
item.description: Former Meta AI director Rohit Patel has left to launch Ndoc, an AI-native startup aimed at competing with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

item.title: Apple Expected to Announce MacBook Pro With Touchscreen Tomorrow
item.description: Apple is expected to announce 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pro models with touch-enabled OLED displays and M5 Pro and M5 Max chips on Wednesday.

item.title: Earnings call transcript: Nucor tops revenue forecasts in Q3 2026
7 Best Python HTML Parsers for Web Scraping in 2026
item.description: Compares seven Python HTML parsers on one 1.22 MB Google page: lxml and selectolax were fastest, html5lib slowest, all found the same headings.

item.title: Fenerbahce condemn brawl after loss to Galatasaray
item.description: Fenerbahce condemned a brawl that broke out after their 2-1 Super Lig derby defeat to Galatasaray and called for an investigation.

item.title: Coding From the Himalayas With an Offline AI Agent
item.description: A Thomson Reuters principal engineer explains how to set up and run an offline coding agent on a laptop using OpenCode, Ollama and Qwen.

item.title: US government says hackers are now exploiting critical PHP web bugs
item.description: US agency CISA says hackers are actively exploiting two critical PHP bugs and has ordered civilian federal agencies to patch within three days.

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO strategy? Cloak itself in altruism
item.description: Anthropic’s cofounders, including CEO Dario Amodei, left OpenAI because they believed AI safety features should be developed alongside model capabilities from the very start of the development process.

item.title: London-based Machenta, which is building an AI model that can teach robots new physical tasks after seeing them performed just once, raised a $40M seed
item.description: London robotics startup Machenta raised a $40 million seed round for an AI model that teaches robots new tasks after seeing them done once.

item.title: Reports Say SAIC Audi Has Not Yet Halted Production of Four-Ring Gasoline Cars, Will Provide Lifetime Aftersales Support for Sold Models
item.description: Insiders say SAIC Audi still sells three four-ring gasoline models but will stop selling new four-ring products, while providing lifetime aftersales support.

item.title: Bitcoin mining infrastructure firm Luxor raises $16 million to expand AI business
item.description: Bitcoin mining firm Luxor raised $16 million to expand its AI business and plans to hire about 12 people by year-end.

item.title: TSMC reportedly weighs 20% CoWoS price increase as Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin chips put pressure on packaging capacity
item.description: TSMC is weighing raising prices for its Chip on Wafer on Substrate (CoWoS) advanced packaging technology by as much as 20%, reports Trendforce, citing supply chain sources and local media.

item.title: Anthropic IPO filing calms nerves with signs of healthy growth
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing shows US$16.3 billion in first-half 2026 revenue, up over 1,300% from 2025, with most revenue coming from customers beyond its top five.

item.title: Anthropic Confirms Its Internal Systems Were Accessed: Customer Conversations and Model Weights Unaffected
item.description: Anthropic confirmed some internal sales, HR and IT systems were accessed; customer conversations, source code and model weights were not affected.

item.title: nest-admin before 1.0.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers…
item.description: nest-admin before 1.0.1 has an authentication bypass (CVSS 9.3) that lets unauthenticated attackers forge admin tokens using a hardcoded JWT_SECRET committed in .env.production.

item.title: Anthropic's political problem will get worse before it gets better
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing lists an 'evolving and uncertain regulatory and political environment' as a key risk. With an expected mid-November IPO and new representatives taking office in January, the article argues the company faces more political pressure. Why it matters: Political and regulatory risk is a key factor for Anthropic's IPO, relevant to AI companies and investors.

item.title: 51 pupils, 2 employees at 2 MOE kindergartens get gastroenteritis; Deli Hub Catering ops suspended
item.description: 53 people, including 51 pupils, developed gastroenteritis after eating food from Deli Hub Catering at two MOE kindergartens, and the supplier was suspended.

item.title: Tailscale warns of SSH flaws allowing root privilege escalation
item.description: Cyberdione Labs found 11 unpatched flaws (Tailworm) in Tailscale 1.104.2 and headscale v0.29.5, which could allow credential theft, server crashes, and root privilege escalation.

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing lifts markets but raises AI safety fears. What should S’pore investors know?
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing on Oct 26 helped lift the S&P 500 and Nasdaq after recent tech sell-offs. The prospectus warned that AI could pose 'catastrophic or existential risks to humanity', adding to safety concerns. Why it matters: Touches AI models and markets.

item.title: CF Benchmarks brings Wall Street pricing infrastructure onchain, including data used by BlackRock
item.description: CF Benchmarks, whose indices BlackRock and CME Group use, launched CFB Oracle to give blockchain apps access to its market benchmarks.

item.title: Giving chat feedback gives Anthropic your data
item.description: Thumbs up/down feedback lets Anthropic keep the whole conversation for up to five years and may use it for model training.

item.title: Apple rolls out iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI languages and security fixes
item.description: Apple's iOS 27.2 adds Siri AI in French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish (beta), lets it remember past conversations, and includes security fixes.

item.title: Police are reportedly pulling motorists over because AI algorithms deem their driving patterns 'suspicious'
item.description: An ACLU report says police increasingly use AI and license-plate-reader data to flag drivers' travel as suspicious, enabling pretextual stops.

item.title: Apple is adding an AI chatbot to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers
item.description: Apple is adding a beta AI assistant, built on Apple and OpenAI models, to Keynote, Pages and Numbers for drafting and design tasks.

item.title: High inflation to persist globally into next year, Reuters poll shows
item.description: A Reuters poll of 500+ economists expects high inflation globally into next year, raising 2027 forecasts for 31 of 50 economies.

item.title: Dallas-based Disruptive raised $10B to invest in AI, defense, and software, doubling its AUM, and pivots from single-deal SPVs to a discretionary fund structure
item.description: Dallas-based investment firm Disruptive raised $10 billion to invest in AI, defense and software, doubling its assets under management.

item.title: Meta Slightly Increases Equity Fundraising Plan to $97.5 Billion
item.description: Meta Platforms is raising its planned stock sales to fund AI investments to $97.5 billion, up from $95 billion.

item.title: Malicious apps prey on Russians’ anxiety about fuel prices, drone strikes
item.description: Fake Russian apps posing as fuel-price, police-patrol and drone-strike trackers deliver ZloyRAT, an Android trojan, according to F6 researchers.

item.title: Vendor Key Leak Puts Data of 238,000 Denver Health Plan Members at Risk
item.description: Denver Health Medical Plan says 238,000 members' personal and health information may have been compromised after a leaked key at vendor SquareML.

item.title: Crypto could outperform AI stocks: Wall Street veteran Jordi Visser
item.description: Former Morgan Stanley executive Jordi Visser says crypto could beat AI stocks as AI agents boost crypto demand.

item.title: UK Politician Jess Asato Got Deepfaked. Now She’s Taking xAI to Court
item.description: UK MP Jess Asato, after being targeted by Grok deepfake images, is suing xAI, arguing it unlawfully used her image without consent.

item.title: Apple's iMac with M6 arrives promising a 'huge leap' in AI performance
item.description: Apple's entry-level iMac now has the M6 chip, which Apple says is up to 50% faster in Excel than the M4 model.

item.title: Here Be Monsters: What Do You Still Need to Know When Agents Do the Work?
item.description: CI failed when SonarQube flagged a Codex-written App.tsx for cyclomatic complexity, so the author formatted and inspected the components and logic.

item.title: PHP2Shell: Exploitation Attempts and Remediation Trends
item.description: Wiz has seen a limited number of PHP2Shell exploitation attempts, none successful so far, and has found no public proof of concept.

item.title: Biggest stock listing ever? A look at Anthropic’s IPO by the numbers
item.description: Anthropic's filing sets up what could be the biggest IPO ever, reportedly raising up to $100 billion at up to $2 trillion valuation.

item.title: Apple Creator Studio gets powerful new AI features using OpenAI models
item.description: Apple is adding AI features to its Creator Studio apps using Apple Intelligence and OpenAI models. Final Cut Pro now includes built-in MotionVFX effects and transitions, and Logic Pro adds an AI assistant in beta. Why it matters: Apple's creative apps gaining AI features built partly on OpenAI models, a signal for AI products in mainstream software.

item.title: Quant firms are racing to fund PhDs, build labs as the AI talent war goes on
item.description: Quant trading firms, including G-Research, are funding PhDs and labs to recruit researchers as the AI talent war grows.

item.title: CISA warns of PHP bug exploitation attempts, gives federal agencies days to patch
item.description: CISA listed two PHP vulnerabilities as actively targeted and ordered civilian agencies to patch them by Thursday, without detailing the exploitation.

item.title: Bitcoin miners' move into AI is creating a new market for trading computing power
item.description: Luxor raised $16 million to expand its AI hardware brokerage and computing-power trading business as bitcoin miners move into AI.

item.title: Marissa Mayer Can’t Keep Pretending 'Gender Doesn't Matter'
item.description: Former Yahoo CEO Marissa Mayer went viral for using her new AI app, Dazzle, to name three things she loves about her daughter.

item.title: Apple updates the MacBook Pro with M6 chips
item.description: Apple refreshed its entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro with the M6 chip, adding Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and 24 hours of battery life.

item.title: Tricks from the Past deployed via signed ChatGPT and Claude binaries
item.description: Check Point Research tracks a campaign that uses fake GitHub projects posing as AI desktop apps. The malware is placed beside signed OpenAI and Anthropic executables to load indirectly. Why it matters: Fake AI tool downloads on GitHub are a malware risk for readers following cybersecurity and AI tools.

item.title: Hayes details FLOP’s AI compute derivatives vision after selling his altcoins
item.description: Arthur Hayes, CEO of Flop Labs, proposes measuring compute delivered per AI inference task to derive a spot price for compute in FLOP tokens.

item.title: unclebob/ub-mode
item.description: ub-mode is an agent skill that enforces disciplined software engineering when writing code; it has 1,621 GitHub stars and pairs with quality-gate tools.

item.title: Japanese girl, 16, detained 18 days for alleged crime, develops eating disorder, dies weighing 20kg
item.description: She had been arrested on suspicions of assault.

item.title: SKH, NUH save over $1.1m in annual energy costs with innovations in operating theatres
item.description: Sengkang General Hospital and National University Hospital introduced operating theatre energy-saving innovations that cut power bills by over $1.1 million a year.

item.title: US stocks: S&P 500, Nasdaq open higher as oil pulls back ahead of Fed decision
item.description: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq opened higher on Oct 27 as oil eased ahead of the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision, while the Dow dipped 0.16%.

item.title: KDDI SUMMIT 2026 Keynote Unveils New AI Solutions, Talent Discovery Project with Record Label
Apple unveils the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6, with a 12-core CPU and a 12-core GPU, up to 32GB of unified memory, and Wi-Fi 7, from $1,999 on November 6
item.description: Apple announced the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6, featuring a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU, Wi-Fi 7 and up to 24 hours of battery life. Pricing starts at $1,999, with pre-orders opening October 28 and availability from November 6. Why it matters: Apple's new M6 MacBook Pro sets the pricing and specs for its next laptop generation, a signal for tech markets.

item.title: NTT Docomo Develops "Physical AI Collaboration Platform" to Support Coexistence of People and Robots
Singapore, Indonesia setting up joint task force to probe firms linked to forest fires; hotlines to manage differences
item.description: Singapore and Indonesia will set up a joint task force to investigate companies linked to forest and land fires behind transboundary haze.

item.title: ContextGem 1.0
item.description: ContextGem 1.0 is a free, open-source Python framework for extracting data from documents using LLMs and new decision models.

item.title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A, countering the neocloud disaster narrative
item.description: General Compute, a bare-metal neocloud, raised a $100 million Series A led by Blackbird and Abstract at an $800 million post-money valuation.

item.title: Ok, this guy just LEAKED the EASIEST method to make money in 2026
item.description: Claude Code + YouTube = $62,000/month Nothing complicated (just 13 minutes). Ready for you to replicate from home. 🔖 Save it, you won't see it again.

item.title: Intrinsic Goals for Autonomous Agents: Hierarchical Exploration Captures Future Volitional Action in Drosophila
item.description: Researchers test whether agents trained on intrinsic goals alone can match fruit fly exploratory behavior and neural patterns in a digital twin.

item.title: obra/superpowers: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works
item.description: Superpowers is a software development methodology for coding agents, built from composable skills that make the agent ask what you're building, draft a spec for sign-off, then write an implementation plan. It supports many agent tools. Why it matters: A widely starred GitHub project, with 305,946 stars, offering a structured workflow for AI coding agents.

togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks: LIST OF ALL MY JAILBREAKS
item.description: A GitHub repository of 31 jailbreak-style prompts targeting 25+ AI models, labeled as for research and educational use, with 4,930 stars.

item.title: HKUDS/DeepTutor: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/
item.description: DeepTutor is a Python project for lifelong personalized tutoring, with 44,963 GitHub stars, 1,587 of them added today.
